tasks.subject: Task 1: Untrack .claude/worktrees gitlinks and ignore .claude/
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Remove the two accidentally committed worktree gitlink entries (mode 160000) from the git index and prevent recurrence.

**Files:**
- Modify: `.gitignore`
- Delete from index (not disk): `.claude/worktrees/admin-webapp-v0`, `.claude/worktrees/m5-push-notifications`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
